Description: Identified a pattern that may indicate AWS credentials, risking unauthorized cloud resource access and data breaches on AWS platforms.
Author: Alfred Shen
Message:
Wave E3: perf sprint 2, live re-verification, final re-gate, sizing

GC/object churn (task-free deadline_scope, fewer tasks/events per turn,
GC thresholds 700/10/100): full-GC 127 -> 61 ms, every 6 -> 21 s.
CPU path: dict SigV4 signer (byte-identical to SigV4Auth, 28/28 live),
fast eventstream decoder (4,304/4,304 live messages identical), edge
shedding with per-tenant fair share, pool release without reset.
Misc: R8 retry budget (no floor), R9, pool metrics, listener heartbeats.
Live: 28 calls (ledger 85/87). Final gates all PASS except L1 as written
(200/pod p50 11.7 ms) and K1 (Phase 0 refit). Knee: 75 streams/pod on
the shipped image (p50 9.65 / p95 12.4 ms), 125 with python-build-
standalone; reports/perf/sizing.md.
